The Mysterious Eight-Spoked Circle Hidden in an Ancient Egyptian Wall Carving

A mysterious circular design with eight spokes appears between two ancient Egyptian figures, raising questions about its original meaning and purpose. 

Was it a symbolic representation, an ancient instrument, or something connected to their daily life and beliefs? 

The surrounding hieroglyphs and detailed carvings add another layer of mystery to this fascinating scene. 

What do you think this unusual design represents?
